mapper.select: SELECT class_id ,states ,city ,school_name ,grade ,classes ,create_date FROM class ORDER BY school_name ASC

SELECT c.class_id ,states AS states ,city AS city ,school_name AS school_name ,grade AS grade ,classes AS classes
,p.student_name AS student_name
FROM class c LEFT JOIN class_member cm ON c.class_id = cm.class_id
LEFT JOIN parents p ON c.class_id = p.class_id AND p.member_id = cm.member_id
WHERE cm.member_id = #{memberId} AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(c.create_date, 'yyyy') || '-03-01', 'yyyy-MM-dd') + INTERVAL '1' YEAR > TO_CHAR(sysdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY school_name ASC
SELECT class_id ,member_id ,class_pw ,states ,city ,school_name ,grade ,classes ,class_comment ,create_date ,class_state FROM class WHERE class_id = #{classId}
